
Verified reference code from earlier tasks, most relevant first.

Record 1.

entry twin_pick
params u8
ret u8

Twin record used for the tie-break test: returns its argument doubled.

```
fn twin_pick x uchar to uchar
ret add x x
end
```

Record 3.

entry clamp_sub
params u32 u32
ret u32

Returns a - b when a >= b, else 0; never traps.

```
fn clamp_sub a uint b uint to uint
if ge a b
ret sub a b
end
ret 0
end
```
